verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਰਹਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਖਸਮੈ ਦਾ ਭਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh haumai paraharai man bhaavai khasamai dhaa bhaanaa|

en.bdb: Gurmukh repudiates ego and he likes the will of God.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: pairee pai paakhaak hoi dharageh paavai maan nimaanaa|

en.bdb: Becoming humble and falling at the feet he becomes dust and earns honour in the court of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਰਤਮਾਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹੋਵਣਹਾਰ ਸੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: varatamaan vich varatadhaa hovanahaar soiee paravaanaa|

en.bdb: He always moves in the present i.e. never ignores the contemporary situations and side by side accepts whatever is likely to happen.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਕਰੈ ਸੁਕਰਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: kaaran karataa jo karai sir dhar ma(n)n karai sukaraanaa|

en.bdb: Whatever is done by the creator of all the causes, is gratefully accepted by him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਜਾਇ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਨੀਆਂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਮਿਹਮਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: raajee hoi rajai vich dhuneeaa(n) a(n)dhar jiau mihamaanaa|

en.bdb: He remains happy in the will of the Lord and considers himself a guest in the world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੀ ਵਿਸਮਾਦ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਾਦਰ ਨੋ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: visamaadhee visamaadh vich kudharat kaadhar no kurabaanaa|

en.bdb: He remains elated in the love of the Lord and goes sacrificed unto the feats of the creator.
Living in the world he remains detached and liberated.
